items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I went to hear her and to tell you the truth I wasn't too impressed with her. She's a big, fat ugly chick.

ctx.x: Look, I may have. I wouldn't say I hadn't, I didn't. I may have, but there was so much going on. There were so many people around in those days that I probably heard her. But I remember distinctly hearing Ma Rainey, because Ma Rainey was pretty popular in those days, and she was coming to the Lafayette and there was talk, you know, for about a month before she got there. I said, 'Gee, whiz, Ma Rainey must be terrific. I've got to hear her,' you know. And I went to hear her and to tell you the truth I wasn't too…
Known as the ugliest woman in show business.
